title: OpenAI is making big claims as it rolls out ChatGPT Health to everyone
summary: OpenAI is rolling out ChatGPT Health to everyone in the US on Thursday, allowing more people to connect their medical records and health-tracking information to the chatbot. During a briefing, Ashley Alexander, OpenAI's vice president of health product, says the company's models "are now capable of reasoning at levels that are better than clinician level." […]
title_es: OpenAI expande ChatGPT Health a todos los usuarios
bajada: OpenAI lanza ChatGPT Health en toda EE.UU., permitiendo conectar registros médicos y datos de salud al chatbot. La empresa afirma que sus modelos ahora razonan a nivel superior al de clínicos, aunque estas afirmaciones requieren validación rigurosa.
bajada_en: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Health nationwide in the US, allowing users to connect medical records and health data to the chatbot. The company claims models now reason at clinician-level or better, though such claims require rigorous validation.

title: Lawmakers prepare bill requiring AI ‘kill switch’
summary: Lawmakers are preparing to introduce an "AI Kill Switch Act" that would require AI companies to shut down or throttle their systems on orders from the Department of Homeland Security, according to a report from Politico. Reps. Ted Lieu (D-CA) and Nathaniel Moran (R-TX) are expected to introduce the legislation on Thursday. The news of […]
title_es: Legisladores preparan ley para 'apagar' sistemas de IA
bajada: Representantes estadounidenses preparan la 'AI Kill Switch Act' que permitiría al Departamento de Seguridad Nacional apagar o limitar sistemas de IA. La propuesta refleja preocupaciones crecientes sobre control y seguridad en IA a nivel gubernamental.
bajada_en: US Representatives prepare the 'AI Kill Switch Act' allowing the Department of Homeland Security to shut down or throttle AI systems. The proposal reflects growing concerns about AI control and safety at the government level.

title: OpenAI’s new voice mode makes it to the ChatGPT desktop app
summary: ChatGPT Voice on desktop can work with both ChatGPT Work and Codex to complete tasks and control agents.
title_es: OpenAI lleva modo voz a la app de escritorio de ChatGPT
bajada: ChatGPT Voice ya está disponible en la versión de escritorio, permitiendo interactuar con agentes y completar tareas mediante voz. La integración con ChatGPT Work y Codex amplía los casos de uso para desarrolladores y usuarios empresariales.
bajada_en: ChatGPT Voice is now available on desktop, enabling voice interaction with agents and task completion. Integration with ChatGPT Work and Codex expands use cases for developers and enterprise users.

title: Anthropic updates Claude voice mode with more capable models
summary: Claude's new voice model will let you reschedule your meeting or draft an email.
title_es: Anthropic expande Claude Voice a Opus y Sonnet
bajada: Claude ahora soporta modo voz en sus modelos más potentes (Opus y Sonnet), no solo en Haiku. La expansión incluye integración con apps populares como Gmail, Slack y Canva, ampliando el alcance de la funcionalidad de voz.
bajada_en: Claude now supports voice mode on its more powerful models (Opus and Sonnet), not just Haiku. The expansion includes integration with popular apps like Gmail, Slack, and Canva, broadening voice functionality reach.

title: Claude’s voice mode is now available for Opus and Sonnet
summary: Until now, voice mode has only been available on Claude Haiku, Anthropic's faster but less powerful model. Now the company is making its Opus and Sonnet models available in voice mode, and extending its reach into apps like Gmail, Slack, and Canva. When Anthropic launched voice mode last year, it was primarily focused on delivering […]
title_es: Claude Voice ya disponible en Opus y Sonnet
bajada: Anthropic expande su modo voz a modelos más capaces tras lanzarlo inicialmente en Haiku. La disponibilidad en aplicaciones como Gmail, Slack y Canva democratiza el acceso a interacciones de voz con IA más potente.
bajada_en: Anthropic expands voice mode to more capable models after initially launching on Haiku. Availability in apps like Gmail, Slack, and Canva democratizes access to interactions with more powerful AI voice capabilities.

title: AMD takes on Nvidia with its Helios AI rack-scale system
summary: AMD is challenging its chipmaker rival with a new rack-scale system that will start shipping to customers later this year.
title_es: AMD desafía a Nvidia con su sistema Helios
bajada: AMD presenta Helios, un sistema AI a escala de rack que compite directamente con las soluciones de Nvidia. El sistema comenzará a enviarse a clientes a finales de año, intensificando la competencia en infraestructura de IA.
bajada_en: AMD announces Helios, a rack-scale AI system competing directly with Nvidia's solutions. The system will ship to customers later this year, intensifying competition in AI infrastructure.

title: AegisAI, founded by former Google security execs, lands $36M to stop AI-driven spear phishing
summary: AegisAI co-founders developed AI agents that quickly analyze each message as a human would, paying attention to small anomalies that even the most elaborate checklist wouldn’t catch.
title_es: AegisAI recauda $36M para combatir phishing con IA
bajada: Startup fundada por ex-ejecutivos de Google de seguridad recauda $36M para detectar spear phishing impulsado por IA. Los agentes de la compañía analizan mensajes detectando anomalías sutiles que escapan a checklists tradicionales.
bajada_en: Startup founded by former Google security executives raises $36M to detect AI-driven spear phishing. The company's agents analyze messages detecting subtle anomalies that traditional checklists miss.

title: DARPA, U.S. Air Force fly AI-controlled F-16
title_es: DARPA vuela F-16 controlado por IA
bajada: El Departamento de Defensa y la Fuerza Aérea estadounidenses demuestran el vuelo autónomo de un caza F-16 controlado por IA. El logro marca un hito en la aplicación militar de sistemas de IA en aviación de combate.
bajada_en: US Department of Defense and Air Force demonstrate autonomous flight of an AI-controlled F-16 fighter jet. The achievement marks a milestone in military AI applications in combat aviation.

title: I built an open-source multi-agent SDLC harness that beats a cold Claude Code run on large repos, by learning the repo once. Real benchmarks (incl. where it loses) inside. [P]
summary: Built an open-source AI coding agent that was 7%–75% cheaper than a cold "claude -p" run on 6/6 well-localized tasks across repositories up to ~82k LOC.The biggest difference:Cold agent: $6.83, 207 turnsAutoDev Studio: ~$1.70 for the same bugThe full benchmark (including cases where it loses) is in the README.So what's different?Most AI coding agents re-explore a repository from scratch on every task just to figure out where the change belongs.AutoDev Studio pays that localization cost once.It ingests a repository and builds a persistent knowledge base using static analysis and a local embedding index. Every future task reuses that knowledge, turning localization into a lookup instead of another cold search.What it does:PM agent asks clarifying questions and drafts ticketsDev agent writes code on an isolated branchQA runs testsA different model family reviews the diff (author ≠ reviewer)If needed, it goes through a bounded revise loopOpens a real GitHub PRIt also includes a live Kanban board and tracks token usage and cost per ticket/agent.Where it doesn't win:Tiny, easy-to-find edits can be cheaper with a single-shot agent because of the pipeline overhead.On one complex cross-cutting bug, it produced a cheaper but narrower fix than the baseline.Other features:Provider agnostic (Anthropic, Claude Code, OpenAI-compatible APIs, Groq, Gemini, xAI, OpenRouter, Ollama, etc.)Runs completely free/offline by default using Groq's free tier + local embeddingsFastAPI + SQLiteHand-rolled UITests + CIMIT licensedRepo (screenshots + full benchmark):https://github.com/krishagarwal314/autodev-studioI'd love any feedback, criticism, or contributions. Happy to answer questions about the architecture or benchmarking.submitted by/u/NeighborhoodOwn8510[link][comments]
title_es: AutoDev Studio: agente de código open-source más eficiente
bajada: Desarrollador lanza AutoDev Studio, un agente multi-agent open-source que reduce costos 7-75% comparado con Claude solo en tareas de código. La herramienta ingiere repositorios una sola vez, reutilizando contexto para futuras tareas.
bajada_en: Developer launches AutoDev Studio, an open-source multi-agent tool reducing costs 7-75% compared to Claude alone on coding tasks. The tool ingests repositories once, reusing context for future tasks.

title: Startup founders urge U.S. government not to shut off Chinese open weight AI
title_es: Fundadores piden no bloquear IA abierta de China
bajada: Fundadores de startups de IA urgen al gobierno a no restringir el acceso a modelos abiertos chinos. El debate refleja tensiones entre protección nacional, competencia comercial y acceso global a tecnología de IA.
bajada_en: AI startup founders urge government not to restrict access to open Chinese AI models. The debate reflects tensions between national protection, commercial competition, and global AI technology access.

title: At AI Summit, South Korea Outlines Its AI Future With NVIDIA and Partners
summary: At this week’s AI Summit in San Francisco, South Korean President Jae Myung Lee and some of the country’s top business leaders and researchers are meeting with NVIDIA and ecosystem partners to chart Korea’s AI progress. Building on NVIDIA founder and CEO Jensen Huang’s visit to Korea last month, this week’s discussions and announcements advance […]
title_es: Corea del Sur planea su futuro en IA con Nvidia
bajada: El presidente de Corea del Sur se reúne con líderes de Nvidia y partners para definir la estrategia de IA del país. Las discusiones buscan acelerar el progreso en IA mediante colaboración público-privada.
bajada_en: South Korea's president meets with Nvidia leaders and partners to define the country's AI strategy. Discussions aim to accelerate AI progress through public-private collaboration.

title: NVIDIA AI Supercomputer Comes Online at Naval Postgraduate School
summary: NVIDIA founder and CEO Jensen Huang today visited the Naval Postgraduate School in Monterey, California, to commission an NVIDIA DGX GB300 system — bringing one of the world’s most powerful AI platforms fully online for the students, researchers and faculty at the U.S. military’s flagship graduate university. “Our nation depends on our men and women […]
title_es: Nvidia activa supercomputadora IA en escuela naval
bajada: La Naval Postgraduate School recibe un sistema DGX GB300, una de las plataformas de IA más potentes del mundo. La instalación refuerza la capacidad de investigación en IA de la institución militar estadounidense.
bajada_en: Naval Postgraduate School receives a DGX GB300 system, one of the world's most powerful AI platforms. The installation strengthens the U.S. military institution's AI research capabilities.

title: How AI guardrails are impeding the work of offensive cybersecurity researchers
summary: We spoke with several cybersecurity researchers, who look for unknown vulnerabilities and develop tools to exploit them, about how OpenAI’s and Anthropic’s guardrails affect their work.
title_es: Guardrails de IA limitan investigación en ciberseguridad
bajada: Investigadores de ciberseguridad ofensiva reportan que los guardrails de OpenAI y Anthropic dificultan su trabajo de encontrar vulnerabilidades. La tensión entre seguridad preventiva y seguridad investigativa requiere soluciones matizadas.
bajada_en: Offensive cybersecurity researchers report that guardrails from OpenAI and Anthropic hinder their work finding vulnerabilities. The tension between preventive and investigative security requires nuanced solutions.

title: Claude Cookbook
title_es: Anthropic lanza Claude Cookbook para developers
bajada: Anthropic publica su Claude Cookbook, una colección de ejemplos y patrones para desarrolladores usando la API de Claude. El recurso facilita la implementación de casos de uso comunes con el modelo.
bajada_en: Anthropic publishes Claude Cookbook, a collection of examples and patterns for developers using Claude's API. The resource simplifies implementation of common use cases with the model.

title: Hetzner is working on LLM Inference
title_es: Hetzner trabaja en inferencia de LLMs
bajada: El proveedor de hosting Hetzner desarrolla capacidades propias de inferencia de modelos de lenguaje. La iniciativa promete mayor acceso a infraestructura de IA con opciones alternativas a proveedores dominantes.
bajada_en: Hosting provider Hetzner develops its own LLM inference capabilities. The initiative promises broader access to AI infrastructure with alternatives to dominant providers.
